page.content:
1942–43 urban battle that ended Germany's eastern advance.

How Battle of Stalingrad connects

  • Faction: Nazi Germany — The Sixth Army's destruction at Stalingrad broke Germany's eastern offensive.
  • Event: Operation Barbarossa — Stalingrad was the later turning point of the war Barbarossa began.

What is Battle of Stalingrad?

Stalingrad destroyed the German Sixth Army and marked the turn in Europe. After the surrender of January 1943, the strategic initiative in the east passed to the Red Army.

Key threads lead to Nazi Germany and Operation Barbarossa.
